all_risks.source_quote: Any macroeconomic downturn, global recession, or abrupt slowdown in technology spending could sharply reduce customer demand.
Furthermore, geopolitical tensions and trade restrictions, especially involving China, could dampen international sales and complicate supply chains.
In terms of competitive risks, NVIDIA operates in a highly dynamic semiconductor industry with fierce competition from well-capitalized rivals like AMD and Intel.
